name: EVK043027B Smart Washer
description: Shizuku: an eight-screen Sharp-class drum-washer panel at 480x272 for the STM32F746G-DISCO and the EDT EVK043027B - a drum that fills and turns from Modbus registers, Sharp's course vocabulary in Japanese, English and Traditional Chinese, a NIAH suggestion, drawn auto-dose tanks and care steps, and a latched fault sheet.

logicGraphs.name: phase
logicGraphs.description: Every 250 ms: the Phase register picks what Running and Idle show (only when it changes); WaterLevel sets the drum mask in 10 % steps; DryMin = 0 and ReserveHours = 0 show なし.

logicGraphs.name: router
logicGraphs.description: Every 250 ms: Phase 8 opens Finished once (doneShown); ErrorCode > 0 opens Fault once (alertShown) with the matching code, title, remedy and drawing.

logicGraphs.name: fault_ack
logicGraphs.description: alert_ok: clear the latch, write ErrorAck = 1, and go back to Running (Phase 1–7, 9) or Home (Phase 0, 8).

logicGraphs.name: course
logicGraphs.description: Every 500 ms: CourseId → the frame's tile (shown only in its own category); Category → the visible group, pill marker and caption; CourseId and NiahCourseId → the course-name stacks.

logicGraphs.name: levels
logicGraphs.description: Every second: tank levels, auto-dose, hot water, temperature, locks, the filter, bubbles and the greeting — each flag shows one thing and hides its twin.

logicGraphs.name: link
logicGraphs.description: Every 500 ms: a Heartbeat that has not moved for four ticks (2 s) greys the dot and says 通信なし; the first fresh one restores 通信中.

logicGraphs.name: countdown
logicGraphs.description: Once a second: a fresh RemainMin restarts secs at 59, otherwise secs − 1 down to 0; the hairline shows 59 − secs. A dead link freezes it at the end of its minute.

logicGraphs.name: step_wash_dn
logicGraphs.description: step_wash_dn: WashMin − 3, kept within 0..25; the readout follows the poll.

logicGraphs.name: step_wash_up
logicGraphs.description: step_wash_up: WashMin + 3, kept within 0..25; the readout follows the poll.

logicGraphs.name: step_rinse_dn
logicGraphs.description: step_rinse_dn: RinseCount − 1, kept within 0..4; the readout follows the poll.

logicGraphs.name: step_rinse_up
logicGraphs.description: step_rinse_up: RinseCount + 1, kept within 0..4; the readout follows the poll.

logicGraphs.name: step_spin_dn
logicGraphs.description: step_spin_dn: SpinMin − 1, kept within 0..9; the readout follows the poll.

logicGraphs.name: step_spin_up
logicGraphs.description: step_spin_up: SpinMin + 1, kept within 0..9; the readout follows the poll.

logicGraphs.name: step_dry_dn
logicGraphs.description: step_dry_dn: DryMin − 30, kept within 0..120; the readout follows the poll.

logicGraphs.name: step_dry_up
logicGraphs.description: step_dry_up: DryMin + 30, kept within 0..120; the readout follows the poll.
